item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.116
item.description:
Release 1.0.116 adds several CLI and editor integration fixes, including MCP/server startup and auth handling, sandbox and permissions behavior, session and model workflow improvements, and multiple terminal/UI accessibility corrections. It also includes changes for extension manifests, workspace MCP config parsing, search and diff edge cases, and memory growth reduction in long sessions.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Semantic Reranker in Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB now generally available supports a Semantic Reranker for search, which reorders candidate results using an AI model that considers the meaning of the query and surrounding context. The feature is intended to improve relevance by promoting better-matching documents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Full-text search in Azure DocumentDB
item.description:
Azure DocumentDB now supports full-text search in public preview. The preview includes BM25 indexing, relevance-based sorting, relevance scores, fuzzy search, and proximity search.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Search and filter for budgets now available
item.description:
GitHub Billing’s “Budgets and alerts” page now lists all budgets in one place and adds search and filter capabilities. This makes it easier to find specific budgets in accounts with multiple entries.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: Announcing: Table discovery in OneLake Catalog search
item.description:
Starting October 15, 2026, Microsoft Fabric search will return tables from semantic models, lakehouses, and mirrored databases as separate results in OneLake Catalog search. Users will be able to find tables by name, description, or an exact column-name match.

  • Source: Azure Updates
